description.fun: Regigigas made Regieleki out of pure electricity, and its whole body is a single organ that generates enough power to supply all of Galar. Ancient people who feared it seem to have fitted it with insulating rings to hold it back, and it's said that taking them off would unleash its hidden power. Its round shape looks a lot like a light bulb, and its arms like arcs of electricity.
description.guide: An Electric-type Legendary Pokémon from The Crown Tundra and one of the legendary giants created by Regigigas. Regieleki has the highest base Speed of any Pokémon.
description.tagline: Living electricity, held back by insulating rings
